title: Implement Ping Tool
description: Create basic health check tool that returns 'pong'. Tool must be registered with MCP server, return 'pong' when called, Cursor can successfully call the tool, and MCP server shows as Connected in Cursor settings.
details: Sprint 0 - Project Setup. First functional MCP tool for health checks and validation.
testStrategy: Call ping tool from Cursor, verify it returns 'pong', check MCP server connection status in Cursor.
